data.one_liner: Provides a CircleFlag widget to display circular country flag SVGs.
data.what_it_does: The package ships SVG assets for many countries and a CircleFlag widget that renders them as round icons. It supports preloading, case‑insensitive ISO codes and accessibility options.
use_when: You need to show country flags in a UI without custom assets
You want a lightweight, ready‑to‑use flag widget with preloading for smooth scrolling
avoid_when: You require custom flag designs or non‑SVG formats
You need a large, regularly updated flag set beyond what the package provides
strengths: Simple API and ready‑made flag assets
weaknesses: Limited to the bundled flag set

alternatives.name: flutter_svg
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need generic SVG rendering and want to manage flag assets yourself
